thread:
tyler: Quick heads-up from staging perf runs — seeing a steady latency uptick on qwen-14b (mixtral config). Batch=8, seq_len=1024. 95th went from ~110ms to ~145ms on decode. Seems tied to kernel selection: FlashAttention attempted -> Triton kernel launch error -> fallback to SDPA.
sara: Can you paste the exact logs / error so we know which check triggered the fallback?
tyler: Pasted logs from the worker:
```
[2027-06-22T12:03:11Z] flash_attn: selecting kernel flash_attn_fp16_sm80
[2027-06-22T12:03:11Z] flash_attn: head_dim=96 not supported by selected kernel -> fallback to sdpa
[2027-06-22T12:03:11Z] triton: kernel launch failed: invalid shared memory size
[2027-06-22T12:03:11Z] runtime: using sdpa fallback path
```
devin: Interesting — qwen uses head_dim=96 which isn't a multiple of 128. Our selector should either choose a flash kernel that can handle 96 (via padding) or prefer a fallback that preserves the KV layout. Right now the fallback path switches KV layout which explains extra memcpy.
anjali: Measured numbers from micro-profiles: when we fallback to SDPA we see an extra ~0.8ms per token due to KV reshuffle + another ~10-15% on attention cost. Combined with batch/seq distribution this explains the 30-40% tail increase. Also noticed that mixed-batching different head_dims in the same batch triggers kernel recompile penalties.
tyler: Raw numbers from the trace (batch=8):
- Flash (good path): median=98ms, p95=110ms, tokens/s=5400
- SDPA fallback: median=130ms, p95=145ms, tokens/s=3800
- Extra memcpy cost: ~0.8ms/token
perf-bot: Perf-check alert: regression detected vs baseline 1797654321 at commit abc123. Linked PR that touched kernel_selector: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4245
sara: That PR removed a conservative pad-to-128 in kernel_selector to reduce memory waste. The intention was good, but we lost a safe path for some architectures. We need a more nuanced heuristic.
devin: Proposed fixes:
1) kernel_selector: compute pad = ((head_dim + 7) // 8) * 8; allow flash if pad-head_dim <= 32 (i.e., <=32 extra channels) OR if head_dim % 16 == 0. This prefers small padding but avoids huge waste.
2) enforce batch partitioning by head_dim so we don't mix incompatible models in one batch (split batches at request coalescer).
3) make SDPA fallback preserve KV layout (keep packed kv format) to avoid memcpy.
anjali: Also add a runtime flag to force padding for specific model families (qwen/mixtral) until we have kernel-level support. Short term mitigation.
tyler: I'll file follow-ups: assign @devin to the kernel_selector patch, @sara to batching/coalescer split, @anjali to kv-layout parity change.
devin: I'll open PR for kernel_selector and include microbench harness results. Quick patch plan: add candidate kernels that accept padded dims and a cost model that accounts for pad overhead vs memcpy cost.
sara: For coalescer change, we should avoid splitting into tiny batches; implement 'split-by-key' where key=head_dim/arch. If mixed requests are present, prefer two batches rather than one heavy recompile.
anjali: KV change note: SDPA implementation currently expects kv as [num_heads, head_dim, seq] while flash path uses packed flattened layout. I can add a thin adapter that keeps storage layout identical and calls SDPA kernel with reinterpret_cast — should remove memcpy overhead.
tyler: Can someone run the bench command after patches: `./bench --model qwen-14b --batch 8 --seq 1024 --profile --trials 50` and paste p95? Would like baseline vs patched within 24h.
devin: will run on A100-80GB instance and post numbers to this thread.
anjali: quick local smoke shows fdifft: p95 down from 145ms -> ~115ms with patched kv layout + kernel_selector pad heuristic (still needs more runs).
tyler: Great. Also note Triton version on staging where issue triggered: 2.1.1. Ops, are we pinned?
ops-bot: @channel deploy job queued: runtime/tables/patch-kernel-selector -> staging (job 5821).
perf-bot: Reminder: add a perf test for head_dim boundaries (multiples of 8/16/32/128) to CI to catch regressions.
sara: Will add test matrix. Also add a lint rule to warn on removing pad heuristics without perf signoff.
tyler: Thanks team. Summary: kernel_selector heuristic tweak, batch split by head_dim, KV layout parity for SDPA fallback. Assigned: @devin @sara @anjali. Will monitor staging over next run. :thumbsup:
